set_text.text: A reorder point is the stock level on a line that says the next order has to go in now. It holds enough stock to cover sales until the truck unloads, plus a buffer for surprises. With this calculator's defaults, that level is 709 cases.
Time, priced in cases. It takes the days you wait on a supplier and states them as a stock level you can check on the floor.
Cases already on the way. The basic sum checks the floor only, so hold the trigger against stock on hand plus stock on order, or you order twice.
When accounts order on one day
A day of usage is an average. When most accounts order for Monday's trucks, 141 cases of headroom can go in a single morning.
Who uses a reorder point calculator

It is built for independent food distributors who buy from their own suppliers and hold stock in their own warehouse. Anyone who decides when the next supplier order goes out should run it line by line.
